entities.name: Maritta
entities.description: A Ravnican mother who bars her family's door against the Rakdos parade.

entities.name: Darux
entities.description: A towering Rakdos spiker and former champion who broke from Stroko's ring and now leads his own ring as ringmaster.

entities.name: Vildika
entities.description: A tall human Rakdos champion who dethroned Darux, left Massacre Girl's ring for his, and represents his ring in the Slaughter Games.

entities.name: Stroko
entities.description: A goblin ringleader devoted to Rakdos who used Darux as a Spiker and insulted him after his defeat.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A Rakdos ringleader whose ring Vildika came from and who treated her as a trophy.

entities.name: Reneir
entities.description: A Rakdos ringleader who has groomed the spiker Erzadalt for years.

entities.name: Erzadalt
entities.description: A hulking spiker from Reneir's ring, whom Vildika dismisses as hardly ready.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demonic leader of the Rakdos guild, who watches the Slaughter Games with interest.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The carnival guild of Ravnica, organized into rings led by ringmasters, which holds the Slaughter Games.

entities.name: Slaughter Games
entities.description: A deadly Rakdos competition between rings, held irregularly, with a vacated territory as this time's prize.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled city-plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: The Rakdos guild parades through the streets to open the Slaughter Games while Maritta bars her door and shelters her children.
events.quote: Maritta slammed the door and slammed down the crossbar.

events.summary: In a flashback, Vildika defeated Darux in the last Slaughter Games with a spinning kick from her bladed boots, ending his reign as champion.
events.quote: Darux found himself defeated and Vildika crowned champion for the year's games.

events.summary: In a flashback, Stroko insults the defeated Darux at a feast and Darux storms out, tearing off his vest to start his own ring.
events.quote: He tore off his vest that bore the sigil of Stroko's ring and threw it down before storming out.

events.summary: Darux marches past Maritta's door at the head of his own ring.
events.quote: Darux now marched past Maritta's door, his ring marching around him.

events.summary: Darux recruits Vildika away from Massacre Girl and finds himself falling for her.
events.quote: Only a few weeks ago he had recruited Vildika away from Massacre Girl.

events.summary: As ringmaster Darux chooses not to compete and lets Vildika represent his ring.
events.quote: As the ringmaster, Darux had begrudgingly chose not to compete, instead allowing Vildika to represent his ring in the games.

events.summary: Darux's ring enters the festival grounds and sets up camp as night falls.
events.quote: Darux led his ring to the area he had chosen for their camp

events.summary: Vildika tells Darux she left Massacre Girl because she was treated as a trophy.
events.quote: I was her trophy to parade around, not a member to share the carnival with.

events.summary: Darux reveals he wagered the majority of his ring's stockpile on Vildika.
events.quote: he had wagered the majority of his ring's stockpile on Vildika.

relations.note: Darux was formerly Stroko's Spiker, until he broke away.
relations.quote: Darux's previous ringleader was the very unusual Stroko

relations.note: Darux left in outrage after Stroko's insult.
relations.quote: Darux, outraged, rose to his feet so quickly that he knocked over the feast table

relations.note: Darux has been falling for Vildika.
relations.quote: he had found himself falling for her.

relations.note: Vildika now belongs to Darux's ring.
relations.quote: I joined your ring because it was clear that she no longer saw me as anything but a combatant in the games, a trophy.
He was earning Rakdos' approval through his work outside of the arena now.

relations.note: Darux is a ringmaster of the guild.
relations.quote: It was up to the ringmasters to organize, fund, and let the carnival continue in order to please Rakdos himself.
